input.title: Password manager explainer: One key. Every login.
input.styleReason: Friendly flat illustration with simple shapes and one idea per beat, matching the brief's flat style and friendly colors.

beats.name: Chaos
beats.description: A messy pile of 5-6 sticky notes (each with a short password line) pops in with Back Out, then jitters anxiously with small fast rotation wobbles. Caption-free; the jitter says it all.
beats.style: Back Out pops 0.3-0.4s, staggered 0.08s; jitter is a small expression wobble with different periods. Coral, teal, amber notes on cream.

beats.name: Gather
beats.description: The notes lose their jitter and are pulled on arcs into a navy shield/vault icon at center, shrinking as they arrive. The shield is already visible underneath and its lock draws in at the end of the gather.
beats.style: Expo In on the pull (no hard cut: notes overlap the start of beat 3 window), stagger 0.05s, scale to 0 at the shield center.

beats.name: Resolve
beats.description: The shield pulses with a soft teal glow, a check mark draws on, and the headline 'One key. Every login.' lands below. Final hold on the lockup.
beats.style: Cubic Out draw-on 0.5s, headline fades up with Cubic Out, glow is a radial halo scaling 90 to 110 and fading.

input.notes: Palette: background #FFF8F0, ink #22313F, coral #FF7F50, teal #2EC4B6, amber #FFBF69, navy #3D5A80, white highlights. Type: Inter 700 headline ~72px. 1920x1080 30fps. Notes carry short fake passwords (e.g. 'hunter2'-style placeholders, not real credentials). Beats overlap by about 0.4s so each hands over to the next.
